scope: Independent read-only review of the actual aux151 typed reader and A5 denial-only wrapper.

basis: NativeRowCreditGate Authorization is Infallible and authorize has no success branch.
Every CreditUse resolves the same typed rows then returns a typed Rows failure or MissingOwner.
No legacy S/K/V certification lookup or fallback is present.
SignedCreditInputs has private construction, borrows the actual state and remains a data bundle, not native authority.

classification_review.missing_route: PositiveRowErrorV2::MissingKernelRoute remains distinct from an absent aux151 row.
classification_review.missing_row: An absent required key is reported with its exact NativeRowKey.
classification_review.malformed_row: Bounded decode, version, shape and key/body identity failures remain MalformedRow with the original ContractError.
classification_review.signature: ContractError::Signature at bundle validation becomes Authentication with ResultAndFunding or Witness stage.
classification_review.bundle_links: Other cross-row signed bundle/plan identity failures remain BundleLinks rather than absent rows.
classification_review.other_core_errors: Remain typed Core denials; never successful or empty fallbacks.

clippy_evidence_note: The existing rows-clippy-initial exit-zero execution is not a new review execution. Parent/credit owner may append the known original environment/base/source metadata without relabeling it as another run.
limits: AcceptedOrigin and its recorded admission clock remain untrusted row data until the native acceptance/lineage owner authenticates them.
Signature and snapshot membership do not establish local arithmetic replay, real coin locks, resources, dependency exports or actual drawn-P Certified approval.
Serialized PositivePassed/Matched and P statements cannot construct missing owner capabilities.
The static missing-owner set deliberately denies all credit even for a well-formed signed row bundle.
The existing tests import already-owned DTO rows through public carriage surfaces; they are not native admission, peer IBD validation, live UTXO locking or multi-node/reorg tests.
The common-native-rows log at its earlier recorded base is evidence for those recorded row-codec tests, not a claim that later certification-module tests were rerun.
